finding: Projected binding, quest ownership, trade, and destruction restrictions are enforced atomically at item lifecycle boundaries.
sources: existing single-owner and atomic rollback invariants
assumptions: Metadata keys are inactive unless explicitly projected.
Administrative removal is Reforged compatibility infrastructure and is not evidence of unrestricted Classic behavior.
safe_fallback: Reject prohibited ownership changes or destruction without mutating the item; preserve unknown Classic semantics for the native pass.
runtime_impact: Prevents projected bound or quest items from changing owners, prevents no-trade staging, and prevents ordinary destruction of protected instances.
character_save_impact: Persists binding and quest ownership metadata with validation against authoritative owned locations.
world_state_impact: Administrative removal explicitly releases the instance only after non-empty-container safety checks.
